what_it_does: Customer service platform for ticketing, help center, messaging and voice support.
auth_notes: OAuth access tokens (Bearer) are recommended; authorization code flow (PKCE for public clients) and client credentials flow. API tokens (Basic email/token:key) are being retired: new accounts created on or after July 28, 2026 cannot create or use API tokens, existing accounts cannot create new ones after Oct 27, 2026, and all are deactivated April 30, 2027. Apps distributed to multiple customers must use a global OAuth client; regular OAuth/API tokens are not permitted for that.
access_notes: Free 14-day trial. Marketplace developers can get a non-expiring sponsored 'd3v-' Support account (up to 5 agents) via a request form. The trial page does not explicitly state trial API access, though an admin can create OAuth clients in Admin Center.
api_notes: Ticketing (Support), Help Center, Voice, Sell and other REST APIs; OAuth tokens are tied to the single instance where the client was created unless it is a global client.
human_needed: request sponsored d3v- account and submit global OAuth client request via Zendesk Marketplace portal for review

what_it_does: AI-first customer service platform with messenger, inbox, tickets and help center.
auth_notes: Private apps use a workspace Access Token from the Developer Hub (Authorization: Bearer). Public apps accessing other workspaces must use OAuth. Whether public OAuth apps need Intercom review before install was not confirmed (only App Store listing references a publishing process).
access_notes: Free development workspaces via developer signup, unlimited number. Limits: US region only, max 20 users/leads, no outbound email/push, watermarked Messenger, cannot convert to production. Some APIs return 403 'API Plan restricted' depending on plan.
api_notes: Versioned REST API (e.g. 2.11) covering contacts, conversations, tickets, help center, reporting, data events etc.; plus Canvas Kit, webhooks, Fin Agent API.

what_it_does: Freshworks helpdesk for ticketing, knowledge base and omnichannel customer support.
auth_notes: Personal API key (Profile settings) sent via HTTP Basic as apikey:X. Endpoints list OAuth 2.0 scopes (e.g. freshdesk.tickets.view) but the API docs do not document an OAuth flow for third parties.
access_notes: 14-day free trial, no credit card, all features. API docs state trial accounts have a 50 calls/minute limit, confirming trial API access. No ongoing free plan shown.
api_notes: v2 REST: tickets, conversations, contacts, companies, agents, groups, roles, solutions, custom objects, SLA, automations, time entries, etc. Rate limits vary by plan.

what_it_does: Shared inbox and customer operations platform for team email, chat and SMS.
auth_notes: API tokens (admin-only, company-level, with feature/namespace/permission settings) or OAuth; both used as Bearer. Public integrations for all Front customers must use OAuth unless Front grants an exception.
access_notes: Free development account via developer signup, not tied to production. Default dev account allows 2 channels (community post); plan requirement for API tokens not stated.
api_notes: Core API covering conversations, messages, contacts, inboxes, teammates, tags etc.; breadth inferred from docs/token settings, full reference not opened.

what_it_does: B2B customer support platform across Slack, Teams, email and chat.
auth_notes: Admin-created API tokens (Settings > API Tokens, role-scoped) sent as Authorization: Bearer. No OAuth for the REST API documented; the MCP server is OAuth-only.
access_notes: No free plan or self-serve signup; pricing page routes to 'Book a demo' and free trials for prospects are set up by a sales rep. REST API, scoped tokens and webhooks included on Professional, Advanced and Enterprise; sandbox on Enterprise only.
api_notes: ~22 resource groups: accounts, contacts, issues, messages, knowledge base, custom objects, tags, tasks/projects, teams, users, surveys, audit logs, etc.
human_needed: book a demo with Pylon sales to obtain a trial org

what_it_does: Omnichannel help desk with ticketing, live chat, call center and social channels.
auth_notes: API v3 key sent in 'apikey' header; created by admin at Configuration > System > API with per-key permissions. Separate legacy v1 keys. The built-in MCP server supports OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) or a Bearer token, but the REST API is API-key only.
access_notes: 30-day free trial, no credit card. API key count is plan-limited (Starter 1, Team 5, Business 10, Enterprise unlimited). Trial API access not explicitly stated.
api_notes: REST API v3 with a Swagger/OpenAPI descriptor; documentation lives inside each account's agent panel (admin/owner only), so the resource list was not verified.
